The evidence confirms: 1) It uses a multiresolution hash grid and MLP decoder (neural network) for appearance representation. 2) It is applied to surfels (splats) for rendering. 3) After training, the residual is evaluated over the spatial atlas and stored in a static RGB atlas, removing the need for network inference during rendering (baking). All facts in the claim are present in the evidence.
